description: APEX Blindfold, Layer 2 test vectors: fixed ballots with their validity proofs, challenge hashes and voter signatures. Exported by a browser; every implementation must reproduce the challenge hashes byte for byte.

encoding.framing: every field is a 4-byte big-endian length followed by its bytes; text is UTF-8
encoding.challenge: the first 128 bits of the SHA-256 of those bytes
encoding.bit_proof: e0 | e1 | z0 | z1 in hexadecimal: 32 + 32 + W + W characters, W = hexadecimal width of n
encoding.sum_proof: e | z in hexadecimal: 32 + W characters
encoding.signature: ECDSA P-256 over SHA-256, r | s (IEEE P1363), 64 bytes; public key as SubjectPublicKeyInfo
